evidence_required: Written answer distinguishing TDP from peak draw and naming the absorbing stages.

marking.criterion: TDP is the sustained design power and default power limit; instantaneous draw can exceed it for microseconds to milliseconds
Microsecond excursions are absorbed by board capacitors, voltage regulators and PSU hold-up
Step-boundary swings (tens of ms to seconds) are seen by PSUs, PDUs, breakers and the UPS

title: TDP versus peak power
